chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama'ah, from more than one of our companions, from Aban ibn 'Uthman, from some of his companions, from Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام:

Concerning a boy, when he grows up and chooses Christianity, while one of his parents is Christian or [they are] two Muslims, he said: “He is not to be left [upon that], rather he is to be disciplined toward Islam.”

key_terms.يُتْرَكُ: is left alone or allowed to remain
key_terms.يُضْرَبُ عَلَى ٱلْإِسْلَامِ: is disciplined or struck in order to be made to adhere to Islam
key_terms.ٱلصَّبِيِّ: the boy or minor under discussion in the legal case

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling in Tahdhib al-Ahkam on a youth who chooses Christianity after reaching maturity?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a child who reaches maturity and then chooses Christianity despite parental religious affiliation mentioned in the report. The Imam عليه السلام states that such a person is not to be left upon that choice, but is to be compelled through disciplinary means toward Islam.
